title: Finite affine refinements of algebraic-space tests over an fpqc scheme covering
statement: Let S and T be schemes [def-pc-scheme], X an algebraic space over S [def-trf-algebraic-space], f : X → T an S-morphism, and {g_i : T_i → T} an fpqc scheme covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For every affine scheme Z over S and S-morphism h : Z → T there exist an algebraic space A with a cartesian square A → X over Z → T, an integer n ≥ 0, indices i(j), affine schemes W_j over S with morphisms w_j : W_j → T_i(j), algebraic spaces B_j with cartesian squares B_j → X ×_T T_i(j) over W_j → T_i(j), and maps r_j : B_j → A such that every field-valued point class of A is in the image of some |r_j| [def-a1-space-point-topology]. No quasi-compactness assumption on f or any local base change is made, and no quasi-compactness conclusion is asserted.

source.place: Tag 041L (lemma-descending-property-quasi-compact), affine-test cube; Tags 022B and 022D, finite affine refinement and fpqc base change; Tag 03H4 (lemma-points-cartesian), compatible point lifting.

proof.text: Regard T and the affine test Z as representable algebraic spaces [def-trf-scheme-algebraic-space]. Form A = X ×_T Z and Z_i = Z ×_T T_i by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. The latter projections form an fpqc covering by [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering-axioms].

Apply the defining affine refinement condition [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering] to all of the affine scheme Z. Obtain finitely many affine opens W_j in the Z_i whose images cover Z. Write i(j) for the member and w_j : W_j → T_i(j) for its second projection. Form B_j = (X ×_T T_i(j)) ×_{T_i(j)} W_j using [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. The chosen pullback projections give the displayed cartesian squares. Associativity of pullbacks identifies B_j with A ×_Z W_j, giving r_j : B_j → A.

For x in |A| choose a W_j point over its image in |Z|, since these affine opens jointly cover Z. Apply compatible point lifting in [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus] to obtain a point of A ×_Z W_j above x, and transport it to B_j. If the refinement is empty then Z and A have no points, and the covering assertion is vacuous.

lean.statement:
theorem fpqc_finite_affine_test_cover
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) (T : Over S)
    (f : X.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj T) {I : Type v}
    (Tᵢ : I → Over S) (g : ∀ i, Tᵢ i ⟶ T)
    (hg : Presieve.ofArrows (fun i ↦ (Tᵢ i).left) (fun i ↦ (g i).left) ∈
      Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage T.left)
    (Z : Over S) (hZ : IsAffine Z.left) (h : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ yoneda.obj T) :
    ∃ (A : AlgebraicSpace S) (q : A.obj.obj ⟶ X.obj.obj)
      (p : A.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj Z), IsPullback q p f h ∧
        ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n → I) (W : Fin n → Over S)
          (w : ∀ j, W j ⟶ Tᵢ (i j)) (B : Fin n → AlgebraicSpace S)
          (b : ∀ j, (B j).obj.obj ⟶ Limits.pullback f (yoneda.map (g (i j))))
          (c : ∀ j, (B j).obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj (W j)) (r : ∀ j, B j ⟶ A),
          (∀ j, IsAffine (W j).left) ∧
            (∀ j, IsPullback (b j) (c j) (pullback.snd f (yoneda.map (g (i j))))
              (yoneda.map (w j))) ∧
            ∀ x : Point A.obj.obj, ∃ (j : Fin n) (y : Point (B j).obj.obj),
              mapPoint (r j).hom.hom y = x
